children: Amentum Technology received a $572.4 million contract from the U.S. Space Force to support and maintain the Integrated Tactical Warning and Attack Assessment command system at the Cheyenne Mountain Complex.
Work on the cost-plus-incentive-fee contract will be performed at the Peterson Space Force Base in Colorado, and is expected to be complete in September 2033.
Amentum beat out six other offers for the contract.
